title: Vanilla Vertical Slabs
description: This texturepack replaces the shelves with vertical slabs for every woodtype
body:
![Title](https://i.imgur.com/vFIeSxc.png)

# Vanilla Vertical Slabs Texturepack

This texturepack changes the models of the new shelves added in the 25w33a snapshot to vertical slabs. This is a vanilla friendly way to integrate shelves in your building style and offers more variation when building. All models including the new wood types are redone. 

The pack is for people that want to have vertical slabs but are not interested in using a mod to do so.
